team-01.economic_payoff: Rank assets by residual trend shared across several causal horizons after removing the lagged market component; require horizon agreement and trend quality.
team-01.primary_structure: cross-sectional residualization plus multi-horizon directional consensus

team-02.economic_payoff: Test whether lagged funding pressure that disagrees with price displacement predicts a bounded repair while agreement acts only as a veto.
team-02.primary_structure: lagged funding/price disagreement state and conditional repair

team-03.economic_payoff: Test whether a broad cross-section of unusual quote-volume participation confirms directional continuation more reliably than price magnitude alone.
team-03.primary_structure: cross-sectional participation breadth and directional thrust

team-04.economic_payoff: Compare causal short- and long-horizon realized volatility states and test breakouts only when the volatility curve changes regime.
team-04.primary_structure: realized-volatility horizon ratio with price breakout

team-05.economic_payoff: Test whether wide cross-sectional settled-funding dispersion supports a market-neutral carry allocation when funding persistence and price neutrality agree.
team-05.primary_structure: cross-sectional funding carry with dispersion and persistence quality

team-06.economic_payoff: Measure causal quote-volume shocks and test whether price impact persists when participation remains broad and liquidity does not normalize.
team-06.primary_structure: lagged liquidity shock with impact-persistence state

team-07.economic_payoff: Use lagged market correlation and cross-sectional dispersion to choose when relative-value signals should be active, reduced, or directionally tilted.

team-08.economic_payoff: Test whether persistent closing location within completed 8-hour ranges reveals directional auction pressure beyond close-to-close returns.
team-08.primary_structure: range-normalized close location and auction-pressure persistence

team-09.economic_payoff: Estimate causal taker-buy versus taker-sell pressure and test whether persistent aggressor imbalance predicts continuation under strict cost controls.
team-09.primary_structure: taker aggressor imbalance persistence, not volume-surprise breadth

team-10.economic_payoff: Test recurring UTC calendar-boundary flow dislocations with causal state confirmation, without hard-coded timestamp-to-position tables.

team-11.economic_payoff: Compare each asset's causal drawdown depth, duration, and recovery slope to the cross-section; trade asymmetric recovery states.
team-11.primary_structure: relative drawdown geometry and recovery asymmetry

team-12.economic_payoff: Use lagged cross-sectional tail concentration to rotate toward assets with resilient downside beta and away from fragile tail exposure.
team-12.primary_structure: cross-sectional tail concentration and defensive downside-beta rotation
